question: What power to shake the triple world arises from always contemplating a smoke-colored form, O beloved?
premises: One should always contemplate a smoke-colored form.
The triple world is the object of action.
The practitioner gains the power to shake it.
inference: By always contemplating a smoke-colored form, one can shake the triple world.
plain_english: O beloved, by always contemplating a smoke-colored form, one can shake the triple world.
